study.question: After fixed-direction collapse, is the real-click partition's validation advantage carried by its action-centroid distance, by alignment of its binary membership with target-match coefficients, or by their interaction; does residual routing modify either dependence? Observed limitation: r0048 couples radius source and placement. Click-minus-shift AUC is 0.0022137622 with task routing and 0.0030892731 with shared routing, but neither is a radius-only or placement-only contrast. Relative to r0047, direction collapse changed click-partition AUC by -0.0000168388/task and -0.0000258020/shared, and shifted-partition AUC by +0.0000041304/task and -0.0000851794/shared. These are exploratory single-seed results, not equivalence tests. The unchanged joint incumbent remains strongest at 0.6667535475 versus the r0048 click/task anchor's 0.6659894136 and DIN's 0.6555440824.
study.hypothesis: The scalar real-click centroid distance may carry useful action-composition information beyond the count-matched shifted distance, but much of the r0048 difference may instead come from placing two synthetic action values at the real-click events. Factor the match-action summary as c(P)*R(Q)*u plus finite-precision common-mean leakage: P is the placement membership, Q the radius-source membership, c(P) the signed target-match geometry, R(Q)=norm(mu1(Q)-mu0(Q)), and u the inherited fixed unit vector. Cross P and Q within each sample and cross both with residual routing. A real-radius advantage at fixed P supports radius-source utility; a real-placement advantage at fixed Q supports alignment utility; only repeated differences of these contrasts between routing modes support routing dependence. This is consumer-specific predictive attribution under official_offline history, not a causal action effect or removal of all feedback.

Read and hash-verified all four materialized r0048 sources, plus baseline_reference.py and candidate.py. The nearest local mechanism preserves centroid distance while collapsing direction. This proposal separates the distance's partition of origin from the event membership receiving the canonical values. Retains the exact same learned module construction, initialization, loss and gradient owners. This is a local attribution experiment; global novelty is unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Complete the missing off-diagonal cells of P x Q x routing using four standalone modules: real-click placement with shifted-partition radius and shifted placement with real-click radius, each task/shared. The four r0048 diagonal cells supply P=Q references. In FP32 compute the placement means, weighted whole-history mean M, group fraction p, and a second distance from the opposite partition of the same valid action stream. Replace the canonical means by nu_g=M+(g-p)*R(Q)*u only when both placement groups are occupied. Rotation preserves both group counts within every block; therefore the donor has the same support/counts. Empty/single-group histories use the exact original means. Item fields and original history/task masks are never mutated. Only summary action values for rows0/4 consume the replacement. Existing same_partition mode retains the exact r0048 helper arithmetic as a source bridge. No parameters, buffers, RNG, fitted calibration, cross-sample information, new optimizer or new loss are introduced. This replacement intentionally changes contrast distance/energy; it preserves weighted mean, count support, placement, fixed axis and capacity. Local prerequisites: torch, raw parquet and host training CLI are unavailable; source hashes/API were audited, but dataset readiness and frozen feature filtering remain inherited host guarantees, not newly verified local measurements. Verified local preparation: source/syntax/config/schema checks and independent scalar audits passed, as recorded in variant notes. Tensor checks and new model outcomes remain pending. The one failed static validation was a list/tuple comparator issue, not an experiment or a source fix.
predictions: Primary contrasts are validation is_click AUC. For each routing mode, denote A(P,Q). Existing diagonals A(C,C), A(S,S) and new off-diagonals A(C,S), A(S,C) form a full factorial. Real-radius effects are A(C,C)-A(C,S) and A(S,C)-A(S,S). Positive effects on both placements support useful real-partition radius content; null effects weaken its necessity in this consumer.

Real-placement effects at fixed radius are A(C,C)-A(S,C) and A(C,S)-A(S,S). Persistence with shifted radius would localize much of the original diagonal gap to click membership alignment. The P-by-Q interaction is A(C,C)-A(C,S)-A(S,C)+A(S,S). Compute each contrast separately under task/shared routing and their differences; no mechanism conclusion from one favorable cell.

Under fixed parameters and exact arithmetic each transformed valid history has the same total action vector as its source; its centered match summaries equal c(P)*R(Q)*u. Both occupied centroid distance equals donor radius. Item coordinates, pools, ordinal summaries, scorer populations, masks, sample predictions at zero-residual initialization, parameter counts and source gradient owners are invariant. Homogeneous/empty placement groups are identical to the parent helper. These are prospective host certificates, not measurements already obtained.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values, auxiliary mean separately, parameters, allocated GPU seconds, examples processed, wall/train/inference time, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95. Predeclared history slices: empty,1-16,17-64,>64; mechanism slices: one versus two occupied click groups and equal versus unequal radii. Report samples/positives/negatives and insufficient support. Training-derived frequency bins and host-available missing/hour slices remain exploratory unless frozen before execution. No unavailable timestamps or IDs enter forward.
falsifiers: No material radius effect at fixed placement, effects reversing across placements or seeds, or a placement effect without radius effects would weaken the radius-content hypothesis. A scalar information reduction from r0048 alone cannot prove semantic sufficiency or equivalence.

Routing interaction vanishing or reversing in paired repetitions weakens task-conditioning dependence. Changes in dense capacity, optimizer, data passes, source initialization, allowed history or loss invalidate the claimed controlled comparison.

Any donor event outside the same sample's valid history, altered original task mask, use of current target action, sample-coupled calibration or current label invalidates the run. Donor and placement counts must match exactly per block and globally.

Before interpreting host outcomes require same_partition source/forward bridge parity with each r0048 anchor, finite forward/backward on empty/singleton/noncontiguous/homogeneous/both-group cases, unchanged parameter/buffer names and initialization, and zero local action gradients through rows0/4 with unchanged other gradient owners. FP32 scalar-identity checks target atol1e-5/rtol1e-4; BF16 certificates report errors against corresponding FP32 computations and 0.03 relative-to-uncancelled-contraction norm as a predeclared attribution gate. If leakage dominates a nominally zero summary, mark that sample/slice numerically unresolved rather than renormalizing or silently modifying the protocol. Tensor certificates remain pending because this coding environment has no torch.
alternative_explanations: The real-click membership is itself observed feedback and remains available, as do observed pools, ordinal action summaries and auxiliary feedback strata. Opposite-partition radii still use historical actions and can correlate strongly with real radii. This tests a source substitution, not removal of action information or a semantic-versus-context dichotomy.

Swapping radii changes representation scale, energy, nonlinear conditioning and subsequent training trajectories. AUC loss may reflect optimizer adaptation rather than unique information. Real/shifted radii need not be independent, and the shifted radius is not a random placebo. Report their correlations and ratio distribution only through authorized host diagnostics; do not tune a scale using validation outcomes.

The unchanged common mean cancels centered match coefficients analytically but BF16 coefficient/cast error may leak it; altered radii may interact with that leakage. All original other action consumers remain confounders for whole-model claims.

Single-seed validation adaptivity over many trajectories and user dependence limit inferential strength. Prior zero/context replacements (r0024) were poor, stopped observed content beat item replacement (r0037), and residual/reflection trajectories (r0045/r0046) were mixed or unsuccessful; these are neither independent replications nor a general refutation of residual information. No failed receipt appears in the supplied trajectory index; previous_runtime_error is null. Preserve these negative branches and all future failures.

Task and shared routing have the same allocated bank capacity but different active parameter sharing and optimization. The offline released history may include feedback not mature at prediction time; auxiliary labels describe same-user/category/brand actions within24h rather than advertisement-attributed conversions. No production causal or temporal validity claim follows.
